conditions.distribution: Exact Forge 1.20.1 artifacts are required on the managed client and logical server

conditions.world_generation: New structures and template changes apply only to newly generated chunks

change.summary: Expand the Major Update 4 structure catalog and assign one owner for vanilla village, outpost and overlap behavior

modifiers.before: Requested structure artifacts were absent except Ember's Ancient Remnants
modifiers.after: The reduced compatible structure catalog, Structurify, Sift Backport and Improved Pillager Outpost are synchronized through the managed generation

modifiers.before: Better Villages, Trek, Nature's Spirit and later artifacts could replace the same vanilla village set
modifiers.after: Luki's Grand Capitals owns the five vanilla village definitions. One merged Luki-spaced structure set retains each unique Nature's Spirit and Trek village ID once

modifiers.before: Trek and Luki could replace the vanilla outpost structure route before Improved Pillager Outpost templates were selected
modifiers.after: The exact vanilla 1.20.1 structure, structure set and base pool route select Improved Pillager Outpost v5 templates as the final outpost overhaul

modifiers.before: No single global owner prevented physical structure overlap
modifiers.after: Structurify 2.0.43 is the single overlap owner. The pillager outpost and all 23 canonical JEM boss structures are excluded from overlap prevention
Structure Layout Optimizer 1.0.11 is active with seed-parity-changing pool deduplication disabled

modifiers.before: StructBlend 1.0.3 shaped the terrain around ordinary structures
modifiers.after: Use native structure terrain adaptation for new chunks after removal of StructBlend

modifiers.before: The expanded settlement catalog had no automatic road-network owner
modifiers.after: RoadWeaver 2.1.1-1.20.1-jem.1 plans ground-anchored roads between the village tag and the priority vanilla pillager outpost on both logical sides. Canonical boss structures remain outside its whitelist

modifiers.before: Luki's Woodland Mansions uses the unsupported value field for a Forge 1.20.1 loot-table reference
modifiers.after: A narrow Paxi override uses the required name field and retains the native minecraft:chests/woodland_mansion target

modifiers.before: Official Forge 1.20.1 artifacts required Java 21 and could not load in the Java 17 pack runtime
modifiers.after: Version 1.0.5.1 is rebuilt and production-reobfuscated from pinned MIT upstream commit 82a7428b31e29bcebaa127c3118214c9f17421fa with class version 61 and unchanged gameplay source

cause.owner: Native structure mods, Paxi compatibility data, Structure Layout Optimizer, Structurify, RoadWeaver and Sift Backport

rationale.purpose: Add the requested exploration catalog without duplicate structure-control systems or lost critical boss arenas
rationale.decision_source: The user selected the content mods, required Improved Pillager Outpost priority and requested a final non-duplicated structure-control combination
rationale.implementation_choices: Keep native artifacts, resolve exact vanilla resource collisions through narrow Paxi data, use one performance owner and one physical-overlap owner, and reject unsafe whole-structure respawn or unneeded dimension policy

introduced.summary: Add the compatible structure catalog with Luki village ownership, Improved outpost priority and one overlap owner

history.summary: Inspected exact artifacts and collisions, rejected incompatible Sift files, loaded the corrected local server and preserved protected boss structures
Remove Oh The Trees You'll Grow and the Dungeons and Taverns ancient-city datapack, replace StructureOverlapless with Structurify and add the Java 17 Sift Backport.
Replace the Mojmap development JAR with the Forge 1.20.1 SRG production artifact while preserving Sift content and gameplay.
Replace upstream RoadWeaver with the disclosed JEM ground-anchor patch after backward slope smoothing raised low endpoints and generated unbounded terrain walls
Remove the StructBlend terrain pass at the user's request.

relations: Luki's Grand Capitals -> vanilla village definitions
merged villages structure set -> Luki, Nature's Spirit and Trek unique villages
vanilla outpost route -> Improved Pillager Outpost templates
Native terrain adaptation -> surrounding terrain in newly generated chunks
RoadWeaver -> asynchronous roads for villages and the priority pillager outpost
canonical campaign structures -> unskippable overlap policy
JEM boss lifecycle -> boss revival without whole-structure rewriting
recorded road terrain -> one-direction slope profile -> bounded ordinary road fill
notes: Ember's Ancient Remnants remains installed once
Better Villages and its generated config are removed
StructureOverlapless, Respawning Structures and Dimensional Structure Restrict are not installed
Oh The Trees You'll Grow and both Dungeons and Taverns artifacts are removed
MineRENT, main, stable JustEnoughMods and the immutable release baseline remain unchanged
Already generated terrain walls are preserved until a separate world-repair request identifies their exact chunks
unresolved: Fresh-chunk generation and player acceptance were not performed
